clauses.mechanism: termination of the War Manpower Commission by EO 9617 sec. 1(c) (parent body ended; no effective-date wording, read as effective on signing)
clauses.reason: item 1: Paragraph 1 of Executive Order No. 9139 is amended to read as a new paragraph establishing the War Manpower Commission within the Office for Emergency Management and fixing who its members are. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 the restatement continues, amended, until the parent ends. EO 9617 section 1(c) says "is hereby terminated" of the War Manpower Commission (printed 'The War Manpower Commission' at the end of one line and the verb phrase on the next), with no effective-date wording, so the Commission and its composition clause ended on signing, September 19, 1945. Before and after: before the amendment paragraph 1 described an earlier membership; after it, the restated membership applied until the Commission ended. The substance of the paragraph changed (a whole-paragraph rewrite).

clauses.mechanism: one_time_revocation_performed_on_signing_date (no effective-date wording; read as effective on signing)
clauses.reason: item 2: Paragraph 1 of Executive Order No. 9279 of December 5, 1942 is hereby revoked (the words are printed across two lines). The order states no effective date, so the revocation was performed on signing, December 23, 1943; the filing date, December 24, 1943, is not used. It is a one-time command exhausted by performance, and paragraph 1 of EO 9279 stays revoked as a surviving consequence.

research_rationale:
EO 9409 (signed December 23, 1943; F.R. Doc. 43-20397, filed December 24, 1943) was read in full in the registered held text (machine-extracted text layer of the official Federal Register PDF, grade original_representation_unverified, under jobs/fr-originals); the heading, body, signature, date and filing line were read; page images were not compared. Item 1 restates, by amendment, paragraph 1 of EO 9139 of April 18, 1942 to set the composition of the War Manpower Commission; item 2 revokes paragraph 1 of EO 9279 of December 5, 1942. The held text goes on to print EO 9410 (delegation of Selective Service functions) and a contents page; they are other orders and were not used. Item 2 is a one-time revocation performed on signing, 1943-12-23. Item 1 is a strike-and-insert restatement that, under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21, continues until its parent ends; the Commission ended when EO 9617 (signed September 19, 1945; 10 FR 11929) section 1(c) terminated it, with no effective-date wording, so on 1945-09-19. The whole-order end is the later date, 1945-09-19. AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification.

savings.reason: EO 9617 section 1(a) transfers the functions, officers, employees, records, property and funds of the War Manpower Commission to the Department of Labor and section 6 keeps prior directives relating to transferred functions in effect; the Commission's composition clause itself does not pass, but the transferred functions do.
